dynamic_runtime_policy.purpose: hash_t and mixed_t form the dynamic fallback subsystem for quick code; explicit data structures remain preferred
dynamic_runtime_policy.tradeoffs: using hash_t reduces performance, increases memory usage, reduces compile-time issue detection and static analysis capability, and becomes less readable as surrounding code grows
dynamic_runtime_policy.evaluation_rule: once types are established, follow normal Prism++ rules
dynamic_runtime_policy.exceptions_rule: exceptions must be documented separately and explicitly
dynamic_runtime_policy.unknown_combinations_policy: if a combination is not covered by this config, it is not defined and must be treated as unsupported until specified

current_receiver_rules.string_t_receiver: runtime error for operator[] in current policy
current_receiver_rules.int_float_bool_null_receiver: runtime error for operator[] in current policy

missing_key_behavior.at: checked access, no insertion, failure on miss

future_reserved.string_indexing: reserved for later char_t/byte_t based design

nullable.typed_boundary_bridge_rule: temporary implicit unwrap to wrapped T is allowed only at explicit typed destinations while the current generator remains symbol/type-blind; empty state is a runtime error; the current required-value cast wording is "cast<To>(nullable) cannot convert an empty nullable to a required value"; this bridge must not widen operator candidate sets
nullable.cast_lifting_rule: centralized cast lifting may unwrap nullable<U> to any configured explicit target T through require_value and cast<T>(U); string_t remains the configured PHP-style empty-string exception for empty nullable values; the symmetric inbound bridge cast<nullable<T>>(mixed_t) maps runtime null to empty nullable and otherwise delegates through the configured mixed_t -> T cast
nullable.operator_lifting_rule: centralized generated operators, not the temporary typed-boundary bridge, define nullable participation in unary, binary, logical, relational, mutation, and compound-assignment families; empty nullable operands fail through runtime errors except explicit sentinel comparisons and equality/inequality against non-sentinel values
nullable.arrow_rule: nullable<T>::operator->() is part of the stable wrapper surface; it must require a present value, forward to wrapped T::operator->() when T already exposes it, and otherwise return the address of the wrapped object for direct-object member access

result_or_false.typed_boundary_bridge_rule: temporary implicit unwrap to wrapped T is allowed only at explicit typed destinations while the current generator remains symbol/type-blind; the false-like empty state is a runtime error for required-value conversions
result_or_false.cast_lifting_rule: centralized cast lifting may unwrap result_or_false<U> to any configured explicit target T through require_value and cast<T>(U); string_t keeps the configured empty-string fallback for the false-like empty state
result_or_false.operator_lifting_rule: centralized generated operators define result_or_false participation through the same guarded-value lifting surface used by nullable; the false-like empty state fails through runtime errors except explicit false-sentinel comparisons
result_or_false.sentinel_rule: the public PHP-facing comparison surface remains == false while the runtime implementation uses false_sentinel_t / false_sentinel internally

result_or_bool.typed_boundary_bridge_rule: temporary implicit unwrap to wrapped T is allowed only at explicit typed destinations while the current generator remains symbol/type-blind; the bool states are runtime errors for required-value conversions
result_or_bool.cast_lifting_rule: centralized cast lifting may unwrap result_or_bool<U> to any configured explicit target T through require_value and cast<T>(U); string_t keeps the configured empty-string fallback for the bool states, while a true-state stringifies as the PHP boolean true contract
result_or_bool.operator_lifting_rule: centralized generated operators define result_or_bool participation through the same guarded-value lifting surface used by nullable; the non-value bool states fail through runtime errors except explicit bool/false-sentinel comparisons
result_or_bool.sentinel_rule: the public PHP-facing comparison surface remains == false and == true while the runtime implementation uses false_sentinel_t / false_sentinel and true_sentinel_t / true_sentinel internally; result_or_bool<bool_t> reserves plain bool/bool_t construction for wrapped payload values

result.typed_boundary_bridge_rule: temporary implicit unwrap to wrapped T is allowed only at explicit typed destinations while the current generator remains symbol/type-blind; the error state is a runtime error for required-value conversions
result.cast_lifting_rule: centralized cast lifting may unwrap result<U> to any configured explicit target T through require_value and cast<T>(U); the error state never silently converts to a value
result.operator_lifting_rule: centralized generated operators define result participation through the same guarded-value lifting surface used by nullable; the error state fails through runtime errors except explicit error-sentinel comparisons
result.error_access_rule: wrapper error inspection is explicit through error(); the value path stays on operator->() and the generator lowers $result->error()->... to the wrapper method instead of treating error as a real payload property

exact_scalar_accessors.bool_value: requires kind bool_v, else runtime error
exact_scalar_accessors.int_value: requires kind int_v, else runtime error
exact_scalar_accessors.float_value: requires kind float_v, else runtime error
exact_scalar_accessors.string_exact_access: preferred runtime contract is exact string extraction via the explicit mixed_t/string_t bridge; probe access remains string_if()

probe_accessors.table_if: returns hash_t<mixed_t, mixed_t>* / const hash_t<mixed_t, mixed_t>* for owned/shared table; otherwise nullptr
probe_accessors.shared_table_if: returns shared table handle probe or nullptr
probe_accessors.weak_table_if: returns weak table handle probe or nullptr

dynamic_policy.principle: once runtime operand types are established, follow normal Prism++ rules; exceptions must be listed explicitly
dynamic_policy.implicit_conversions: forbidden unless an operation or cast rule explicitly allows them
dynamic_dispatch_scope: operation dispatch only where explicitly documented
dynamic_policy.operator_resolution_rule: implicit mixed_t to native extraction must not participate in overload candidate expansion; any operator involving mixed_t resolves through mixed_t runtime-kind dispatch only
dynamic_policy.typed_boundary_bridge_rule: implicit mixed_t to native extraction is temporarily accepted only for initialization/assignment, by-value argument passing, and typed return; failed extraction is a runtime error
dynamic_policy.concat_rule: PHP string concatenation (.) and (.=) is generator-owned and must be lowered into explicit text conversion plus primitive string_t concatenation; mixed_t has no independent concat dispatch family

dispatch_contract.delegation_rule: if the established runtime kinds map to an allowed native rule, execute that native rule and box the result when needed; otherwise raise a runtime error
dispatch_contract.compound_assignment_rule: compound assignment is allowed only when the delegated native binary operator exists and assignment back into the stored lhs kind is valid

overloads.when: T is not handle_like and not ref_like

casts.note: the same centralized lifting rule also applies to nullable<U> -> T for any configured explicit cast pair by unwrapping first; string_t remains the empty-string exception

condition.mixed_t_rule: for generic condition coercion and php::ternary_eval, mixed_t currently delegates through the shared condition helper for null, bool, int, float, and string payloads; table/object-like runtime kinds still fail in condition context

deferred_members.note: uint64 needs a u64-safe runtime bridge symbol before full-range source consumption

overload_families.name: nullable_lifted_ops
operands: nullable<T> with nullable<U> or plain U where the wrapped-value operator family is defined
notes: temporary typed-boundary implicit conversion is not the intended operator participation mechanism
operator lifting must stay centralized to keep generated code and overload review deterministic

forbidden_operation_groups.name: mixed_operator_candidate_expansion
forbidden_operation_groups.reason: mixed_t extraction is allowed only at explicit typed boundaries, not for overload candidate creation

notes.purpose: declares stable runtime helper entry points that frontends/generators may target directly
notes.separation_rule: helpers listed here are shared knowledge contracts, not generator implementation details

abi_bridge_identity_standard.purpose: runtime ABI helpers are selected by stable helper keys, operation keys, and optional family ids; compilers must not encode one cast/operator combination per helper call site
abi_bridge_identity_standard.helper_key_rule: helper keys listed in stable_helpers and generator_allowed_helpers are the only generator-visible helper ids
abi_bridge_identity_standard.operation_key_rule: source-visible ABI descriptors use stable operation_key values such as php.text_coercion.int_t or string.compare.lexicographic
abi_bridge_identity_standard.family_rule: repeated source-TypeRef conversions use abi_bridge_rule_families with a stable family_id, member list, and deferred-member list
abi_bridge_identity_standard.text_coercion_rule: new printable source types add coercions.text.abi_bridge_rules or coercions.text.abi_bridge_rule_families plus any needed carrier adapter, not source-specific compiler casts

notes.operator_phase: C++-first operator semantics for numeric and integer-bitwise operators; PHP-only identity and concatenation helpers remain in scpp::php, with strict identity using exact type matching except for null_t versus nullable<T>.

conditional_helpers.coalesce_exact_match_priority: coalesce_result resolves exact same-type pairs first; mixed_t ?? mixed_t is an explicit supported exact-match cell
conditional_helpers.ternary_exact_match_priority: ternary_result keeps an explicit mixed_t ?: mixed_t same-type cell for symmetry with coalesce and future-proofing
conditional_helpers.ternary_mixed_cross_type: ternary_result supports mixed_t ?: T and T ?: mixed_t by normalizing the non-dynamic branch into mixed_t
conditional_helpers.ternary_condition_truthiness: php::ternary_eval uses helper-owned PHP-style truthiness for mixed_t condition values instead of the strict cast<bool_t>(mixed_t) narrowing path

notes: generator emits native C++ lambdas for anonymous functions
generator may emit std::function<R(Args...)> when a concrete callable signature is required
use(&$x) is not covered by this contract version

must_detect: shared operator symbol on both dynamic and native families

compound_assignment_policy.rule: lhs op= rhs is valid iff lhs op rhs is valid and the result type is assignable back to lhs under assignment rules
